speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
text: And the second supplementary question relates to the current Middle East conflict and the war in the Middle East.

speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
text: The current one in the Middle East has driven up the cost of energy, and the cost of oil and natural gas has been extremely volatile.

speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
text: In Singapore, I would like to think that we have planned ahead, and we are always looking at the impact of climate change, as I have mentioned in my answer, and incorporating the impact of climate change in our long-term planning for our water infrastructure.
